performance.verdict: Spend intentionally throttled; intake ownership gap now blocks any scale-up.

findings.text: Zero-spend day confirmed 2026-08-22; spend has been erratic all month — 12 of 28 days at $0 or near-zero, averaging just $24.43/day this week.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completed event; GHL records 0 appointments in the 28-day window against 43 opportunities created.
Intake ownership unresolved: Vivian left 7/7, GHL shows 80 contacts and 43 opportunities but 0 appointments — speed-to-lead automations may be pointing at an empty seat.
3-day spend signal (Aug 20–22): $84.70 → $20.77 → $0. Prior 3 days (Aug 17–19): $18.71 → $16.06 → $21.63. Spend is collapsing further, not stabilising.
GBP actions surged 52% week-over-week to 116 total (35 calls, 45 directions, 36 web clicks) while paid spend cratered — organic is carrying demand the paid channel is abandoning.

suggestions.text: Confirm who owns GHL intake post-Vivian and re-point speed-to-lead automations to the active seat before any budget increase.
